title: Meeting Gene Ammons at the Champion Bar
summary: At the Champion Bar he first met Gene Ammons with King Kolax's band, and heard a bluesy tenor named Effie.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: And also on Hastings Street was a bar called the Champion Bar. That's where I first met Gene Ammons. He came over from Chicago with the King Kolax band -- a trumpet player. And Kolax was from Jackson also, but he left before I came on the scene. Now he's President... He's a union delegate in Chicago. Anyway, I met Ammons and them, and I used to go over there and play with them. I was still
playing my alto at the time, and I used to go and sit in with them. And we had a great rapport. I had a lot of great times over there.

The next, though, was a guy named Effie(?) playing tenor in this real dive. And he had a great sound, playing the saxophone. All he did was play the blues mostly, but he really had a great sound. I can't remember his last name.
